---
entries:
- field: type
  unstated: The material gives the reserving member three days to pick the returned copy up and names no rule keeping other members from borrowing it meanwhile.
  decided: 'policy: a reserved copy is lent only to the member who reserved it until the pickup deadline'
  why: Three days to pick a copy up mean nothing if another member may borrow it on the first of them.
- field: consistency
  unstated: The material does not say how promptly a reservation must stop another member's borrowing.
  decided: eventual
  why: The borrowing is decided in the borrower's aggregate and the reservation lives in the copy's, so the borrowing reads the reservation as last recorded.
---
